native_contract.baseline: pre_contact = first 10% of approach; linear offset + slope
native_contract.calibration: raw_v -> deflection_m (x InVOLS m/V) -> force_n (x k N/m)
native_contract.events: snap-in on approach before contact; pull-off on retract
native_contract.qc: typed reasons; summary score beside component diagnostics
native_contract.work: trapezoid over common tip-position overlap; monotone interpolation

non_claims: no automatic choice of the correct contact method
no uncertainty guarantee from method spread alone
no SMFS or viscoelastic parity from this batch

relations.baseline_offset_invariance: offset correction leaves contact branch shape invariant
relations.event_window_restriction: restricting event windows bounds the search
relations.force_scaling: force scales linearly with spring constant
relations.work_scaling: work scales linearly with force amplitude
